fullServerSuite: Required at pushed final head; per-file verdicts and final aggregate are posted as PR follow-up. The superseded root run is not counted as a pass.

cleanupReview: Shared heartbeat and existing read-fence scheduling retained; two short PG statements surround each guarded non-streaming handler. No read transaction or project lock crosses CH I/O. No new general abstraction or dependency.
